summary.text: Phil Skaggs is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives serving his second term for District 80, which includes Kentwood, East Grand Rapids, Cascade Township and parts of Grand Rapids and Grand Rapids Township.
He previously served on the Kent County Commission and the East Grand Rapids City Commission.

paragraphs.text: Skaggs grew up in Ohio and attended the University of Michigan, where he received degrees in Russian history.
He worked as a professor of history at Goucher College, Grand Valley State University and Aquinas College before leaving academia in 2010.
He then managed campaigns, worked for an environmental organization and served as legislative director for State Representatives Brandon Dillon and David LaGrand.
He served on the East Grand Rapids City Commission from 2012 to 2016 and the Kent County Commission from 2017 to 2022.
He has two daughters and a wife, Kate.
